implementation: Original bounded Swift/Foundation/CryptoKit; no PostScript interpreter or external engine imported

primary_sources.scope: ISO32000-1§7.10/Table38–42 and§7.3.9; public publisher edition consulted locally
PDF2 errata§7.10.3 and§7.10.5: exponent domain constraints and calculator syntax

implemented: Role-aware inventory of Separation/DeviceN tint transforms, Shading/Pattern functions, ExtGState transfer/blackgeneration/undercolor, softmask TR, halftone spot/transfer functions and nested resources/appearances. Private FunctionType keys are not function evidence.
Context input/output dimensionality, exact decimal Domain/Range ordering without Double/Decimal precision loss. Null dictionary entries are omitted, including indirect nulls.
Type0: Size positive integers, supported BitsPerSample, Order, Encode/Decode dimensions, stream required and complete packed sample-table capacity; extra decoded bytes are not falsely forbidden.
Type2: one input, coefficients/defaults, exponent integrality/sign and mathematically valid declared domain.
Type3: one-input child functions, dimensions, ordered Bounds, Encode, child references and cycles; reverse Encode and k1degenerate Domain allowed.

Type4: bounded original brace/token grammar; permitted operators only; straight-line or constant-condition stack type/count and exact integer constant failures. Arbitrary input-dependent execution is not presumed verified.
Explicit input/stream/report/recursion limits and cancellation preserve notVerified; no sampled execution is used as universal validity proof.
remaining: Complete execution/verification of calculator arithmetic over every point of the input domain, with all PostScript numeric representations.
Complete graphic model and every consuming context/codec/extension; resource inheritance, image/color models and full ISO19005 normative crosswalk remain separate obligations.

primary_review.finding: First stitching Bound must be strictly above Domain0; final Bound may equal Domain1. Fixed and regression added.
